extracts.description: Borjas/BGH supply-shock panel: 1980/1990/2000 5pct census + 2010/2023 ACS; STATEFIP AGE EDUC RACE EMPSTAT WKSWORK INCTOT. For immigration-research warehouse (borjas_supply_shock_cell / bgh_outcomes_cell).
extracts.universe: Every person in the 1980, 1990 and 2000 5% censuses and the 2010 and 2023 ACS
used_in: Never downloaded; superseded the same day by extract 2, which adds BPL, CITIZEN and YRIMMIG
extracts.beyond_its_lane: Nothing that extract 2 cannot: same samples, fewer variables.

extracts.description: Borjas/BGH supply-shock panel v2: 1980/1990/2000 5pct census + 2010/2023 ACS; adds NATIVITY (foreign-born flag for immigrant_share) + BPL CITIZEN YRIMMIG (origin/status/arrival) to STATEFIP AGE EDUC RACE EMPSTAT WKSWORK INCTOT. immigration-research warehouse.
extracts.universe: Every person, all ages, in the 1980, 1990 and 2000 5% censuses and the 2010 and 2023 one-year ACS; no SEX, HISPAN or wage variables
extracts.beyond_its_lane: Joined to extracts 10 and 11 it gains SEX, HISPAN, wages, hours and commute for ages 16-64 in 1990, 2000 and 2010, so the Borjas panel can be cut by sex without a new extract (view usa_00002_sex); the flag extracts 6, 13, 14 and 15 mark imputed birthplace, arrival year, education and citizenship for the records they cover (men 18-40 in 1980-2000, the Mexican-born, the institutionalized).

extracts.description: schooling selection lane: Mexico-born, 1980-2000 censuses and ACS 2005-2024
extracts.universe: Every Mexico-born person (BPL 200), all ages, in the 1980, 1990 and 2000 5% censuses and every one-year ACS 2005-2024
extracts.beyond_its_lane: Naturalization, school enrolment and schooling of Mexican-born people by arrival cohort, age and sex for 1980-2024; with extract 12 an unbroken 2000-2024 ACS series, and with extract 13 every figure can be recomputed without imputed education.

extracts.description: immigration-research crime_selection_cohorts: census 1980-2000 men 18-40, GQ detail
extracts.universe: Men aged 18-40, every birthplace, in the 1980, 1990 and 2000 5% censuses, with group-quarters type (institution type only in 1980; 1990 and 2000 say 'institution')
extracts.beyond_its_lane: Institutionalization by birthplace for any origin country, not only Mexico (Cuba, El Salvador, Vietnam, India), against native Hispanic and non-Hispanic white men; arrival-cohort institutionalization for every origin group; in 1980 only, by institution type (correctional, mental, elderly and disabled).

extracts.universe: Mexico-born men aged 18-40 in every one-year ACS 2006-2024 except 2020, with the 80 person replicate weights
extracts.beyond_its_lane: Replicate-weight standard errors for any statistic on young Mexican-born men (citizenship, schooling, state, group quarters) by arrival cohort; with extract 13, education allocation for the same men.

extracts.description: immigration-research crime_selection_cohorts: census 1980-2000 men 18-40, allocation flags
extracts.universe: The same people as extract 4 (men 18-40, 1980-2000 5% censuses) with the allocation flags QBPL, QYRIMM and QEDUC
extracts.beyond_its_lane: How much of any 1980-2000 immigrant-native gap for young men rests on imputed birthplace, arrival year or education, by origin and census year; it flags records of extracts 2, 3, 10 and 11 as well.

extracts.universe: Men aged 18-40 born in the 50 states or DC, in the one-year ACS 2019, 2023 and 2024, with the 80 person replicate weights
used_in: Not yet used; the crime lane ran on extract 9 with a household jackknife (infra/immigration-fiscal/crime_selection_cohorts_2026_09_23/RESULT.md, section on movers)
extracts.beyond_its_lane: Replicate-weight SEs for the interstate mover-versus-stayer comparison (birth state against current state) and for native young men's schooling and group quarters by race, Hispanic origin and state.

extracts.description: immigration-research crime_selection_cohorts: ACS 2006-2024 US-born men 18-40, no replicates
extracts.universe: Men aged 18-40 born in the 50 states or DC, in every one-year ACS 2006-2024 except 2020, main weight only
used_in: Not yet used; the crime lane took its native reference rates from the Census API
extracts.beyond_its_lane: Native reference rates by single year of age, race, Hispanic origin, education and state for 18 years: institutionalization and schooling of US-born Hispanic men (all second or later generation) against non-Hispanic white men.

extracts.description: immigration-research crime_selection_cohorts: ACS 2019/2023/2024 US-born men 18-40, no replicates
extracts.universe: The same people as extract 7 without replicate weights
extracts.beyond_its_lane: Nothing beyond extract 7, which has the same records plus replicate weights; kept because the crime lane's results were computed from it.

extracts.universe: Every person aged 16-64 in the 2000 5% census, the 2010 one-year ACS and the 2009-2011 three-year ACS, with wages, hours, commute, PUMA and 2013 metro area
extracts.beyond_its_lane: Wages, employment and commute time of natives and immigrants by education, citizenship and metro area in 2000 and 2010; the Mexican-born wage gap by citizenship at fixed 2013 metro geography; SEX and HISPAN for extract 2's working-age records.

extracts.universe: Every person aged 16-64 in the 1990 5% census, with the same variables as extract 10 and 1990 metro area and county
extracts.beyond_its_lane: The 1990 baseline for any 1990-2000-2010 metro panel of wages, employment and commute by nativity and education; county-level figures for large counties in 1990.

extracts.universe: Every Mexico-born person, all ages, in the ACS 2000-2004 (the pre-2005 ACS samples, households only)
extracts.beyond_its_lane: Fills 2000-2004 in the annual Mexican-born series of extract 3; sees the 1995-2004 arrival cohorts within a few years of arrival.

extracts.description: schooling selection lane: Mexico-born, education allocation flag
extracts.universe: Every Mexico-born person in the samples of extracts 3 and 12, with the education allocation flag QEDUC
extracts.beyond_its_lane: How often Mexican-born people's education is imputed, 1980-2024, and allocation-robust education for any IPUMS analysis of them; it flags the Mexican-born records of extracts 2, 4, 5, 10 and 11.

extracts.description: immigration-research crime_selection_cohorts: census 1980-2000 institutional men 18-40, nativity flags
extracts.universe: Institutionalized men aged 18-40 (GQ 3) in the 1980, 1990 and 2000 5% censuses, with the flags QBPL and QCITIZEN
extracts.beyond_its_lane: Whether imputed nativity or citizenship drives institutionalization rates for any origin group, not only Mexico; the imputed share of noncitizen inmates by census.

extracts.description: immigration-research crime_selection_cohorts: census 2000 institutional persons, all ages, nativity flags
extracts.universe: Every institutionalized person (GQ 3), all ages, in the 2000 5% census, with the flags QBPL and QCITIZEN; GQTYPE does not name the institution type in 2000
extracts.beyond_its_lane: The institutionalized population of every age in 2000 by nativity, citizenship, arrival year and state, with age standing in for the type the file does not record (65+ mostly nursing homes, young men mostly correctional): e.g. elderly immigrants' institutional care against natives', and how much of it rests on imputed nativity.
